uncertain.342fe4c267bab82f: Hapax (Job 6:17); the sense of zarab is debated ('flow', 'burn', 'wax warm', 'shrink').
uncertain.1de0ec8b094ba976: Hapax (Ps 72:6); zarzif is uncertain: dripping, shower or soaking rain.
uncertain.23b8454a707683cf: Hapax (Prov 30:31); the animal 'girded of loins' is debated: rooster, greyhound, war horse, starling.
uncertain.775381d63e8bbdb7: zaram is rare (2x); in Ps 90:5 'you flood them / sweep them away' is debated.
uncertain.c2af98b1cf8a3b29: Hos 7:9: zaraq usually 'sprinkle'; 'gray hair has sneaked in / is sprinkled on him' is debated.
uncertain.9ad2003825a9a64d: Job 38:30: hithpael of chaba 'hide' glossed 'become hard'; the waters 'hide themselves' or 'harden' is debated.
uncertain.5e23807a440c5152: Prov 13:13: chabal here is read 'be pledged / held in pledge (bound to pay)' or 'be destroyed'; the sense is debated.
uncertain.4676051741e56b22: Josh 19:29: mechebel read as 'from [the] region' or as the place name Mahalab; identification debated.

uncertain.77ffba45a9af8e50: chavatselet (Song 2:1): the flower is debated (crocus, rose, asphodel, narcissus).
uncertain.b4b8674eb35af538: chavatselet (Isa 35:1): the flower is debated (crocus, rose, asphodel, narcissus).
uncertain.f7b56d70c6e53c68: Job 34:17: chavash 'bind' glossed 'govern' (restrain, rule); the sense is debated.
uncertain.b7720db14072f38d: 2Sam 22:46: chagar here is read 'gird themselves' or 'come trembling / limp out'; the sense is debated.
uncertain.46f435fdad1f4d1f: Isa 38:11: chedel 'cessation' is often read as cheled 'world'; the sense is debated.
uncertain.7f81828622dd7d32: Hapax (Ezek 21:14): chadar 'surround' or 'enter into chambers'; the sense is debated.
uncertain.a528873e9c4f239a: Job 41:30: chaddud (rare) 'sharp points of potsherds' describing the creature's underside; the image is debated.
uncertain.774630ff93f93f31: 2Chr 33:19: chozai read as a name (Hozai) or as 'the seers'; identification debated.
uncertain.d07f97680e13a99c: Lam 4:6: 'no hands twisted/whirled on it' (chul) is obscure; the sense is debated.
uncertain.58da23b01f55871c: Ps 29:9: 'causes the deer to calve' or (with a revocalized word) 'whirls the oaks'; debated.
uncertain.c2c60008e25afe51: Mic 1:12: chalah/chul here 'is in anguish', 'waits anxiously' or 'is sick for good'; debated.
uncertain.a94cde49a6e62947: Judg 3:25: chul (hiphil) glossed 'writhed'; usually read 'waited (anxiously)'; the sense is debated.
uncertain.a96a4cbaac3e9b14: Ps 10:5: chil 'endure / be firm / prosper' (his ways); the sense is debated.
uncertain.8fe6f20c4660ae87: Job 20:2: 'because of my agitation (chush) within me' is obscure; the sense is debated.
uncertain.e8dc76d0cd045d40: Eccl 2:25: chush here 'enjoy' or 'worry / hasten'; the sense is debated.
uncertain.9b2b1403e5827a09: Isa 19:9: chorai (hapax) 'white cloth' or 'networks'; the sense is debated.
uncertain.a28a0373fc1b6e2f: Dan 8:5, 8: chazut 'conspicuousness' (a notable horn); the exact sense is debated.
uncertain.cb52d9a5bfdebc6a: Zech 10:1: chaziz 'thunder-clouds' or 'lightning (flashes)'; the sense is debated.
uncertain.880eafd42bbdfc38: chach (Exod 35:22): the ornament is debated (nose ring, hook, brooch, clasp).
uncertain.57d0db93b3dd40e2: Exod 5:16: the noun chatat ('fault, sin') is glossed as a verb; 'the fault is your people's' vs 'you have sinned' is debated.
uncertain.c8b4347d4cf97e37: Job 41:25: hithpael of chata here 'are bewildered / purify themselves / miss (the way)'; the sense is debated.
uncertain.d49a63af90ccd2a0: Hapax (Prov 7:16): chatuvot 'colored / striped fabrics'; the exact sense is debated.
uncertain.618b6731779f8317: 2Sam 23:11: lachayyah read as the place Lehi or as 'into a troop / band'; debated.
uncertain.6052740fb272c25b: Ps 68:10: chayyah 'your community / flock / creatures'; the sense is debated.
uncertain.81682ae655753195: 1Sam 18:18: chay 'kinsfolk / my life'; the sense is debated.
